title: Berne-Provenance MCP Tool Envelope (v1.1+)
description: Drop-in JSON Schema for provenance-safe Model Context Protocol (MCP) responses supporting verbatim quotes, excerpts, multi-source synthesis, and dual-hash binary/PDF records.

content.description: The primary text payload returned by the MCP server or tool.

synthesis_mode.description: Declares whether content is an exact copy ('verbatim'), a direct subset ('excerpt'), or a multi-source summary/blend ('synthesis').

modified.description: Must be false if and only if synthesis_mode is 'verbatim' and the text matches the canonical source digest.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the normalized UTF-8 content payload.

sources.description: Ordered list of upstream authored artifacts contributing to the output.

author_name.description: Canonical human author name (Berne Art. 6bis paternity).

source_uri.description: Canonical upstream DOI, Zenodo record, or origin repository URL.

file_path.description: Relative path within the canonical repository.

license_spdx.description: SPDX license identifier (e.g., MIT, CC-BY-4.0, Apache-2.0).

sha256.description: Primary canonical SHA-256 digest (extracted UTF-8 text for PDFs, raw UTF-8 for text/code).

binary_sha256.description: Optional raw container SHA-256 digest for binary formats such as .pdf.

matched_chunk_hashes.description: Paragraph- or section-level SHA-256 digests referenced in excerpt or synthesis mode.
